name: Ein Haus WOBA
funding: Verein Ein Haus WOBA funds a CHF 130,000 restoration from donations. Named supporters: Sulger-Stiftung, Kantensprung-Stiftung, Vitra, Embru, Horgen-Glarus, Buess AG, Wohngenossenschaft Eglisee and Freiwillige Basler Denkmalpflege.

name: Villa Le Lac
funding: Association Villa Le Lac runs it on support from the Commune de Corseaux, unnamed foundations, companies and individuals, and admission. The Fondation Le Corbusier owns the villa.

name: Haus Duldeck (Rudolf Steiner Archiv)
funding: Rudolf Steiner Nachlassverwaltung income 2025 CHF 1.69M: project grants 948k, donations 445k, rent 167k. Donors over CHF 5,000 include Anthroposophical Societies of Switzerland and Germany, Humanus-Stiftung and Software AG Stiftung.

name: Tishreen War Panorama (October War Panorama)
funding: Run by the Syrian Ministry of Defence, which lists it among its army museums. North Korea helped build it, per Wikipedia and Public Delivery.

name: Turn End
funding: Friends scheme, donations and sponsors: Community Chest, Haddenham Beer Festivals Trust and Haddenham and Waddesdon Community Board. Corporate friends: Allies and Morrison, Foster and Partners. Income £48,418 (2024).

name: The Hill House
funding: The National Trust for Scotland, with 2024/25 income of £91.4M, owns and runs the house. National Lottery Heritage Fund gave £1.1M in late 2024, an anonymous donor £625,000 in 2026.

name: Picker House
funding: Endowed by Stanley Picker, a cosmetics businessman, who set up the Trust in 1976 and left house, gallery and collection to it in 1982. Tour ticket sales go to conservation.

name: Isokon Gallery
funding: Donations, shop sales and venue hire. Named supporters include Heritage Fund, Historic England, Royal Institute of British Architects, Vitra, Artek, Skandium, Paul Smith and Penguin. Income £48,894 in 2025.

name: 78 Derngate
funding: Donations and legacies £132,250 of £146,334 income in 2025 (individuals £19,581, other charities £6,328), rental income £12,237. Friends of 78 Derngate support the Trust. The accounts name no company funder.

name: LongHouse Reserve
funding: Contributions were $1.42M of $1.96M revenue in 2024. Suffolk County, Bloomberg Philanthropies and the Cordish Family Foundation each sit in the $10,000 to $24,999 band of the supporters list.

name: Fay and Gus Jones House
funding: Owned and run by the University of Arkansas since the Jones daughters donated it. The Arkansas Natural and Cultural Resources Council, the university and private donors supported the 2015 restoration.

name: Takaezu Studio
funding: Not confirmed. Quakertown Studio Project, a New Jersey 501(c)(3) filing Form 990-PF, runs it on gifts of $166k in 2023 and $26k in 2024. Donors are not named.
